name: haxeui-bootstrap-theme
description: Bootstrap 5 theme and reactstrap-style component library for HaxeUI: light/dark themes, 12-column responsive grid, bs.* components (button, alert, badge, card, modal, ...), custom css functions.
releasenote: Initial release. Tested on haxeui-openfl (HL, Linux native, HTML5); haxeui-heaps partially (fonts/rounded-pill caveats).
